title: Bounded NCT N-alkyl analog generation with dual solubility evidence
scientific_question: Can a predeclared, chemically narrow N-alkyl series around the measured NCT seed produce valid analogs that retain explicit local AqSolDB coverage while their frozen ESOL applicability-domain status is recorded independently?

solubility_evidence.reason: MOLDISC-004 observed a 2.3096117645502643 logS absolute error for the measured NCT seed despite IN_DOMAIN status.

generated_analog_followup_rule.eligible_if: chemistry PASS and nearest AqSolDB Tanimoto >= 0.4
generated_analog_followup_rule.selection_among_eligible: highest nearest AqSolDB similarity, then variant_id ascending
generated_analog_followup_rule.if_none_eligible: close MOLDISC-005 without selecting a generated analog

interpretation_boundaries: Generated N-alkyl analogs are E0_HEURISTIC candidate structures, not evidence of biological activity.
The NCT AqSolDB measurement applies to the exact NCT structure and does not transfer to generated analogs.
Frozen ESOL predictions and AD status are recorded for every analog but are not used as the analog-selection score because MOLDISC-004 observed a large seed-level absolute error.
AqSolDB Tanimoto coverage is structural measured-source coverage, not proof of equal solubility.
No docking, affinity, potency, efficacy, safety, metabolism or clinical claim is made in MOLDISC-005.
